evaluations.question: Wie hoch ist der Gesamtrueckgang der russischen Importanteile ueber alle drei Rohstoffe hinweg in der EU von 2021 bis 2023 (Summe der Differenzen)?
evaluations.model_answer:
The total decrease in Russian import shares across all three commodities in the EU from 2021 to 2023 is calculated as follows:
*   Aluminum: 24.3% (2021) - 1.3% (2023) = 23%
*   Copper: 5.1% (2021) - 1.7% (2023) = 3.4%
*   Nickel: 25% (2021) - 14.6% (2023) = 10.4%
*   Total: 23% + 3.4% + 10.4% = 36.8%
